decisions.reason: The correction restores USB ESD protection and normal USB operation but does not change whether the integrated board can operate from USB without a battery.
Correcting the USBLC6 symbol connections does not change connector placement, enclosure accessibility, antenna clearance, or any other mechanical-layout constraint.
The USB ESD wiring correction does not affect the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The production-package requirement already calls for the latest integrated-board revision; the source does not change its required artifacts or independently require a package update.
Connecting USBLC6 pin 5 to +5V and pin 2 separately to GND does not alter the established high-current-net widths, copper-pour continuity, layer, current, or via requirements.
The ESD device's separate GND connection is unrelated to the button and slide-switch pull-ups, active level, connector grounding, and press behavior.
The USBLC6 symbol correction does not change PWROK, VBACKUP, or VRTC exposure and handling requirements.
The corrected USB ESD pin mapping has no effect on the decision to leave the ESP32 local decoupling capacitors unchanged.
The USB ESD ground and VBUS separation does not affect the PIR or touch-input pull-downs, output behavior, or disconnected-input state.
The USBLC6 schematic correction does not change the AXP2101 stencil-aperture or pre-reflow moisture-control requirements.
The ESD protection correction does not alter the display-backlight connector, switching circuit, supply selection, PWM control, or load constraints.
Correcting the required USB ESD wiring does not modify the board's cost goal, component-tier preference, connector-reduction strategy, or sourcing exception.
